posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina praised Alia Bhatt and Sharvari's Alpha teaser on Instagram, calling it 'fire.' Her team denied comeback rumors, but reports suggest she's eyeing OTT projects for a 2027 return post-maternity.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit's Main Vaapas Aaunga with Imtiaz Ali and AR Rahman releases today (June 12). A special music video 'Kya Kamaal Hai' dedicated to refugees has already gone viral ahead of the premiere.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: The Alpha teaser crossed 75 million views in 24 hours, making it one of 2026's biggest digital launches. Alia's first female-led YRF Spy Universe film releases July 3 with Bobby Deol and Sharvari.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka ranked #3 on Fortune India's Most Valuable Celebrities 2026 — the only woman on the standalone cover. Featured as 'the luxury brand whisperer' by ADWEEK at Cannes Lions while shooting Rajamouli's Varanasi.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK's mega-budget action thriller King is confirmed for Christmas 2026 release. The ₹350 crore film with Deepika, Abhishek Bachchan and daughter Suhana is currently shooting in Mumbai.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena is reportedly in advanced talks to reunite with Salman Khan for a Raj & DK superhero film — their first film together since the blockbuster Bajrangi Bhaijaan over a decade ago.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha's biopic Eetha, based on legendary Lavani performer Vithabai Narayangaonkar, locks its release date for Raksha Bandhan — August 28, 2026. Her most emotionally demanding role yet.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika and Ranveer were spotted at their new ₹100 crore Bandra quadruplex as she's expecting their second child. She's also filming SRK's King and Atlee's sci-fi Raaka with Allu Arjun.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer ranked #5 on Fortune India's Most Valuable Celebrities 2026 after back-to-back blockbusters Dhurandhar and Dhurandhar 2. Spotted at his new Bandra home with pregnant wife Deepika.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya was named global brand ambassador for JW Marriott and closed Cannes 2026 with stunning couture looks alongside daughter Aaradhya. Madhuri Dixit publicly slammed age-shaming directed at her.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika's Cocktail 2 with Shahid Kapoor releases June 19 and is one of Bollywood's most anticipated summer films. She also reunites with Vijay Deverakonda for period action drama Rana Baali.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha's Ma Inti Bangaram releases June 19 — a double-life action comedy directed by Nandini Reddy. The trailer has already sparked major buzz with fans excited to see her in action mode.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun cracked Fortune India's Top 10 Most Valuable Celebrities as Pushpa 2 expanded to 250+ screens in Japan. His next film Raaka with director Atlee and Deepika Padukone is highly anticipated.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's Peddi is a massive hit, crossing ₹250 crore worldwide in its first week and entering the Top 5 all-time Telugu openers on BookMyShow alongside Pushpa 2 and RRR.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: War 2 with Hrithik Roshan and Kiara Advani is confirmed for IMAX release on August 14. Hrithik called Jr NTR his 'favourite co-star' and praised their epic dance-off sequence in the film.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi's action entertainer Lag Ja Gale with Tiger Shroff and Lakshya under Dharma Productions has locked a May 14, 2027 release. A large-scale dance-off sequence is being hyped as a major highlight.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya continues to build her brand after the success of CTRL on Netflix. She's part of the buzzy new-gen Bollywood squad and is reportedly reading scripts for her next big theatrical project.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara stars alongside Hrithik Roshan and Jr NTR in War 2 (August 14), marking her debut in the YRF Spy Universe. She's also in Yash's Toxic, the most expensive Indian film ever at ₹850+ crore.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: War 2 drops August 14 in IMAX with Jr NTR and Kiara Advani. Hrithik revealed the dance-off sequence was 'nerve-wracking' and praised Jr NTR as 'one of the most dynamic performers' in Indian cinema.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun's Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai — his father David Dhawan's final directorial — released June 5 to mixed-to-positive reviews. The rom-com with Mrunal Thakur has earned ₹47.5 crore so far.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya is continuing her All Hearts Tour across cities after earning a Filmfare nomination for 'Saiyaara Reprise.' She cancelled her Surat show to mourn the Pahalgam attack, drawing wide praise for the gesture.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman composed 'Kya Kamaal Hai' for Imtiaz Ali's Main Vaapas Aaunga releasing June 12 — a powerful refugee tribute with Diljit Dosanjh that has already gone viral ahead of the film's premiere.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Vijay's political party TVK smashed the DMK-AIADMK binary in Tamil Nadu's 2026 elections. His final film Jananayagan, budgeted at ₹500+ crore, is eyeing a post-election release window in July.
